prompt.text:
Implement two pure functions and export exactly `{ flipPane, configureSequence }` with CommonJS.

`flipPane(state, paneId)` receives a non-null, non-array object whose own enumerable values must each be either `"0px"` or `"160px"`. `paneId` must be a string naming an own property. Return a new object with that pane changed from `"0px"` to `"160px"` or vice versa. Reject malformed state or a non-string ID with `TypeError`, and reject an unknown ID with `RangeError`. Do not mutate or return the input object.

`configureSequence(items, options)` receives an array of non-empty strings and an optional object. Return `{ items, activeIndex, wrap }`, where `items` is a new array. `options.wrap` defaults to `false` and must be boolean when supplied. `options.startIndex` defaults to `0` and must be an integer when supplied. For a non-empty array, clamp the index into range when wrapping is disabled; when wrapping is enabled, normalize positive or negative indices modulo the array length. For an empty array, `activeIndex` is always `0`. Reject malformed arguments with `TypeError`. Neither function may mutate its inputs.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
